messages.content: I keep waiting for the 'right time' to start something new and it never comes.
Honestly, that's a really common trap - the right time is often a myth that protects us from the discomfort of starting.
That's kind of a hard truth to hear.
Fair, honestly - but it's actually a freeing one too, since it means you don't have to wait for perfect conditions that were never going to arrive anyway.
